dimension.name: metric_timestamp
dimension.description: Timestamp of the recorded telemetry.

dimension.name: cpu_usage_ratio
dimension.description: (ratio) (0-1) Fraction of CPU time not idle averaged across all servers.

dimension.name: cpu_load_ratio
dimension.description: (ratio) (>= 0) CPU load average across all servers and normalized by CPU count. Can exceed 1.0 when the run queue is longer than the CPU count.

dimension.name: memory_usage_ratio
dimension.description: Ratio (0-1) Fraction of total used memory averaged across all servers.

dimension.name: network_in_bytes
dimension.description: (bytes/s) ALL inncoming network throughput for this server, including S3 client traffic, RING inter-node traffic, monitoring, etc.

dimension.name: network_out_bytes
dimension.description: (bytes/s) ALL outgoing network throughput for this server, including S3 client traffic, RING inter-node traffic, monitoring, etc.

dimension.name: objects_count
dimension.description: (count) Number of objects stored on the RING, including replicas.

dimension.name: objects_unique_count
dimension.description: (count) Number of unique objects stored on the RING, deduplicated to count only logical objects regardless of replica count.

dimension.name: objects_missing_count
dimension.description: (count) Number of objects with missing or OOS chunks.

dimension.name: capacity_disk_unique_tb
dimension.description: (TB) Total stored data of unique objects (before replication). Reflects logical data size.

dimension.name: capacity_disk_stored_tb
dimension.description: (TB) Total stored data including replicas.

dimension.name: capacity_disk_used_tb
dimension.description: (TB) Total actual disk space consumed, including various overheads beyond stored object sizes.

dimension.name: capacity_disk_available_tb
dimension.description: (TB) Total free disk space on the RING.

dimension.name: capacity_disk_total_tb
dimension.description: (TB) Total physical disk capacity. Static unless disks are removed from the RING.

dimension.name: disk_read_bytes
dimension.description: (bytes/s) Total disk read throughput summed across all disks.

dimension.name: disk_write_bytes
dimension.description: (bytes/s) Total disk write throughput summed across all disks.

dimension.name: disk_io_time_seconds
dimension.description: (s/s) (0-1) Fraction of time spent on I/O averaged across all disks. A value of 1.0 implies a device spent 100% of its time doing I/O (fully saturated).

dimension.name: disk_errors_count
dimension.description: Overall error count across all disks.

dimension.name: s3_errors_5xx
dimension.description: (errors/s) Rate of HTTP 5xx server errors across all S3 services.

dimension.name: s3_request_get_operations
dimension.description: (ops/s) GET request rate.

dimension.name: s3_request_post_operations
dimension.description: (ops/s) POST request rate (near constant since we are not using multipart uploads in our nominal workload).

dimension.name: s3_request_put_operations
dimension.description: (ops/s) PUT request rate.

dimension.name: s3_request_delete_operations
dimension.description: (ops/s) DELETE request rate.

dimension.name: s3_request_head_operations
dimension.description: (ops/s) HEAD request rate (metadata lookups).

dimension.name: s3_throughput_in_bytes
dimension.description: (bytes/s) Client-to-S3 data rate.

dimension.name: s3_throughput_out_bytes
dimension.description: (bytes/s) S3-to-client data rate (dominates throughput_in in our GET heavy nominal workload).

dimension.name: s3_request_get_latency
dimension.description: (seconds) 95th percentile GET request duration.

dimension.name: s3_request_post_latency
dimension.description: (seconds) 95th percentile POST request duration. Near-constant in our nominal workload.

dimension.name: s3_request_put_latency
dimension.description: (seconds) 95th percentile PUT request duration.

dimension.name: s3_request_delete_latency
dimension.description: (seconds) 95th percentile DELETE request duration.

dimension.name: s3_request_head_latency
dimension.description: (seconds) 95th percentile HEAD request duration.
